notes: Squarepusher Lead XFX - XFX MODE lead voices with 8 CLIP sequences ready on Bank 1 of the Clip launcher, all targeting XFX MODE. Every key from C2 up is a different bright wavetable lead (own unison, filter, envelope and repeat), and the eight clips are fast 16th and 32nd-note IDM runs in a minor pentatonic range at 170 BPM. Press a clip pad to launch it (quantized to 1/4); launch several in turn for call-and-response.
